__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’ · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by ἀντίον: ’them’ (ἀντίον … αὐτῶν ’face to face with them’) · also gen. pl. plain pronoun governed by σχεδόν: ’them’ (σχεδὸν … αὐτῶν ’close to them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with καί, dependent on a noun: ’their own’ (καὶ αὐτῶν θυμός ’their own heart, too’) · also plain pronoun, gen. pl. after ἀήθεσσον: ’them’ (ἀήθεσσον … αὐτῶν ’unused to them’)
__broaden__.βάλλει: βάλλω — throw, cast, hurl; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’casts, throws’ · also pres. 3 sg., of sound: ’strikes’ (κτύπος οὔατα βάλλει ’the din strikes the ears’)

__broaden__.λίπ: λείπω — leave; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λίπ’ = λίπε = ἔλιπε): ’left’ · also λίπα — richly, sleekly (adv.), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα), with ἀλείφομαι: ’richly (anointed)’
__broaden__.λόφον: λόφος — crest, plume (of a helmet; also a ridge); masc. acc. sg. · also nape, neck: ’neck’ (κνήμας τε ἰδὲ λόφον ’shins and neck’)
__broaden__.μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν) · also ’and do not’ with an infinitive used as a command (μηδὲ … καλλείπειν ’and do not leave’) · also ’and not’ continuing a ὅπως clause with opt. __broaden__.πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέρα: ’a great (mist)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with στρατόν: ’a great (host)’ · also masc. acc. sg. form beside fem. ὑγρήν, noun unsaid: ’wide (wet)’; construction not quite clear · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’

__broaden__.τόξῳ: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. sg., after πέλασεν: ’to the bow’ · also dat. of means: ’with the bow’ (τόξῳ ἐπιπλήσσων ’striking with the bow’)

__broaden__.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’) · also ’so that’ + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν ’so that they might pass through’)
